gate_results.gate_id: D2-006-G5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL

observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0003, the H-003 trial_log entry, and the H-003 experiment notebook. H-003 generated positive total PnL but negative full-period Sharpe of -0.40644276086066977, with max drawdown of 109.5869% and unstable parameter sensitivity. The strategy failed 6 of 8 D2-006 gates, and DEC-0003 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: Daily long-only price-band Bollinger mean reversion is not promotable under current promotion gates.
Positive total PnL did not translate to positive risk-adjusted performance; full-period Sharpe was negative.
Max drawdown breached both the D2-006 promotion gate and the pre-registered kill-threshold framing.
Parameter sensitivity was unstable: a +/-25% parameter shift produced a negative minimum ratio to baseline.
WP-4a failure analysis treats this as a rejection of the tested price-band mean-reversion implementation, not of all mean-reversion or structural dislocation ideas.
